name: May 12, 2025 - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu City Council
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice that the Regular City Council Meeting of Monday, May 12, 2025,
is hereby adjourned to Wednesday, May 21, 2025 at 2:00 p.m.

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City Hall,
23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the City Clerk’s
Office at cityclerk@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 228.

  NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE

The following public hearings scheduled for the May 12, 2025 City Council meeting
are hereby continued to the May 21, 2025 Adjourned Regular City Council meeting:

A.  Amendment to Minimum Wage Ordinance – Forgoing the 2025 CPI-W
  Adjustment and Introduction of Corresponding Ordinance

B.  Appeals of Planning Commission Resolution No. 24-13 for Coastal
  Development Permit No. 22-040 – An application to restore a wetland buffer
  that was disturbed due to unpermitted weed abatement

C.  Appeals of Planning Commission Resolution No. 24-021 regarding Coastal
  Development Permit No. 23-019 and Site Plan Review No. 23- 024 – An
  application to construct a new single-family residence, second unit and
  associated development (30053 Harvester Road, Owner, Steven Kent;
  Appellants, Dawn N. Ericson, Paul E Philipson, and Andrea Slosberg-
  Philipson)

Dated: May 12, 2025 at 8:00 p.m.

__________________________________
Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk
